incidents.symptoms: Intermittent payment failures; 5xx errors on the charge endpoint; error rate spiked right after a deploy
incidents.root_cause: A deploy shipped a connection-pool regression; the pool exhausted under peak load and requests were refused
incidents.resolution: Rolled back the deploy; pool sizing fixed in the follow-up release

incidents.symptoms: Card payments fail at authorisation; checkout hangs on the payment step; shoppers see timeouts on charge requests
incidents.root_cause: The payment provider degraded its authorisation endpoint during a certificate rotation, and gateway retries amplified the latency
incidents.resolution: Provider rolled back the certificate change; authorisation latency recovered within 40 minutes
